evals.prompt: I want to set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds my Flutter app, signs it, and uploads to the Play Store when I push a v1.2.3 tag. Where do I start?
assertions: Response directs the user to copy assets/release_workflow.andml to .github/workflows/release.andml
Response mentions configuring GitHub secrets (KEYSTORE_BASE64, KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD, PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON) before triggering the pipeline
Response explains the pipeline is triggered by a semver tag push (v1.2.3 pattern) and describes the pipeline stages: quality gates → build → sign → distribute

evals.prompt: How do I configure Android signing secrets in GitHub Actions so my keystore never gets committed to the repo?
assertions: Response explains base64-encoding the .jks file and storing it as KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret in GitHub repo Settings → Secrets
Response shows that the workflow decodes the secret at runtime: echo "${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" | base64 -d > android/app/keystore.jks
Response mentions adding android/app/keystore.jks and android/key.properties to .gitignore to prevent accidental commits

evals.prompt: How do I configure iOS signing in my Azure DevOps pipeline using Fastlane match? We do not have our own Mac agents.
assertions: Response indicates using vmImage: macos-latest as the Microsoft-hosted agent for iOS builds in Azure DevOps
Response mentions configuring MATCH_PASSWORD and MATCH_GIT_URL as secret variables in the Azure DevOps Library Variable Group
Response references references/fastlane_signing.md for the complete Fastlane match setup, including Matchfile, Appfile, and the release lane

evals.prompt: My CI pipeline is deploanding to production on every push to main. How do I separate staging from production deploandments?
assertions: Response references the Continuous Delivery Strategy section and explains the branch → environment → store mapping (release/* → staging, main/tag → production)
Response explains using different --dart-define values per environment: STAGING_API_URL with IS_PRODUCTION=false for staging, PROD_API_URL with IS_PRODUCTION=true for production
Response recommends using semver tags (v*.*.*) to trigger production deploandments instead of plain pushes to main, and directing release/* branches to Play Store internal track / TestFlight

evals.prompt: How do I upload debug symbols to Firebase Crashlytics automatically after each release build?
assertions: Response shows using --obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/symbols/android (and /ios) flags on flutter build commands to generate debug symbols
Response shows the post-release step: npm install -g firebase-tools && firebase crashlytics:symbols:upload --app=$FIREBASE_APP_ID_ANDROID build/symbols/android/ using FIREBASE_TOKEN secret
Response mentions uploading symbols as a post-release job that depends on both distribute-android and distribute-ios completing successfully

evals.prompt: How do I set up test coverage enforcement in CI?
assertions: Response mentions the quality gate step in the pipeline that uses lcov to enforce an 80% coverage threshold and fails the build if coverage drops below it
Response notes that detailed coverage configuration strategies (exclusions, per-package thresholds, reporting) are outside this skill's scope and references flutter-test-coverage-strategy for that
Response provides the essential snippet: flutter test --coverage followed by sudo apt-get install -and lcov and the lcov --summary check pattern
